reason: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py:876-882, OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result falsely claims Django handles negative slicing and passes cursor.offset (< 0) directly into queryset[start_offset:stop], which raises ValueError on Django QuerySets (BaseQuerySet does not override __getitem__). Because Cursor.from_string (src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:51-59) accepts negative offsets like '0:-5:0', OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint enables this path with enable_advanced_features=True (src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:70-83), and Endpoint.paginate only catches BadPaginationError (src/sentry/api/base.py:525-542), the unhandled ValueError surfaces as a 500.
